test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 16 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9de2784696ec6b89c371df5d7efac487152f02bbd7db31f9fcda124a807e6b58.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) The arrow is rotate 90º anticlockwise in the every next figure.

2) Square is shift their position form right upper corner in second figure, then right bottom corner in third figure at last left bottom corner in fourth figure and increase the number square in the next figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53bc89d676a035cb3286dbbd527204275843773c94a573578ec2b55d6d49ad4f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
